subject: On-prem commitment and engineering retainer — proposal
messages:
From: Amit Sharma <amit.sharma@vertexhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: On-prem commitment and engineering retainer

Marissa —

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Vertex is aligned internally to move to a 3-year on-prem (VPC) deployment with an initial committed capacity of ~120 TFU/month (we'll provide a list of expected peaks shortly). Before we get internal procurement and legal to start redlining, two asks from my side:

1) Can Redwood apply an engineering retainer credit against the first-year platform fee if we commit to the 3-year term? Our Security and Integrations team will need ~2 FTEs of Redwood engineering time across onboarding and the first 6 months to complete the SSO/KMS integration and offline data validation hooks.

2) We'd like clarity on the support tiers mapped to the commit bands — specifically on response times for Severity 1 incidents and any included architecture hours per year.

Can you send a short commercial note with the retainer-credit options and a sketch SOW we can circulate to procurement?

Appreciate it —
Amit
Procurement & Vendor Ops
Vertex Health

(Attachment: Vertex_onprem_requirements.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Sharma <amit.sharma@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-29T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: On-prem commitment and engineering retainer

Amit —

Thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise commercial proposal and an indicative SOW (attached) to help procurement and legal. High level:

Summary (3-year, 120 TFU/mo commit)
- Platform fee (annual, billed annually): $1,200,000/year base (covers runtime licensing + management plane).
- Committed compute (metered): pricing tiers below reflect committed discounts on per-token/runtime usage.
- Engineering retainer: standard 1 FTE equivalent / month for onboarding = $180k/year. We can apply a credit against the first-year platform fee on the engineering retainer if you: (a) sign a 36-month commitment AND (b) pre-pay year 1 platform fee. Options we can offer:

  Option A — Standard: No credit; retainer billed separately at $180k/yr (recommended if you prefer cashflow separation).
  Option B — 50% credit: if Vertex prepays year-1 platform fee, we will credit 50% of the annual engineering retainer ($90k) against year-1 platform fee.
  Option C — 100% credit cap at $120k: for a 3-year commitment + minimum annual spend guarantee of $3.6M/year across platform + committed compute, we will credit up to the full engineering retainer (capped at $120k) against year-1 platform fee and include 40 architecture hours/year as part of Support Tier 2.

Support tiers (mapped to commit band)
- Tier 1 (Standard): 8x5, 4-hour Severity1 response, 16 architecture hrs/year.
- Tier 2 (Enterprise): 24x7, 1-hour Severity1 response, 40 architecture hrs/year + quarterly on-site/remote architecture review.
- Tier 3 (Premium): 24x7, 30-min Severity1 response, 80 architecture hrs/year + named SLA manager and weekly check-ins.

SLA uplift request: We can provision Tier 2 with a 99.9% uptime target for the runtime portion — higher SLA requires Dedicated on-call and increased capacity reservation.

Attached: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (onboarding milestones and deliverables) and pricing_model_v3.xlsx (detailed line items).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Let us know which retainer-credit option you prefer (A/B/C).
2) If procurement wants a capped credit schedule, we can convert Option C into a clean SOW clause for redlining.
3) Once you indicate preference, I'll loop in Legal and David for final pricing approval.

cc'ing David (pricing) and Stephanie (support) to confirm internal alignment.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

(Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf, pricing_model_v3.xlsx)

From: Amit Sharma <amit.sharma@vertexhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-30T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: RE: On-prem commitment and engineering retainer

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear options. A few clarifying points from procurement/security leaders:
- Option B (50% credit) is reasonable if the credit is applied immediately to invoice 1 following pre-pay.
- Option C looks attractive but our CFO is pushing back on pre-pay requirements. Would Redwood consider a 50% credit for pre-pay OR a tiered credit if we sign a standard net-45 (no pre-pay) but commit to the full 36 months and an annual minimum spend? e.g., credit 30% year-1 retainer if net-45 paid, 50% if pre-pay.
- On SLA: Vertex requires a 30-min Severity1 acknowledgement window for production escalations tied to a penalty clause (service credit) for downtime beyond agreed targets. Is Redwood willing to accept a capped service credit (0.5% monthly fee per hour over target, capped at 10% monthly)?

Finally, procurement will need the SOW to explicitly list the deliverables for the 2 FTE-months of integration work, including SSO/KMS playbook and data validation checklist. Can you update the SOW to show tasks by milestone?

If we can get a clear path on the credit and the SLA language, we can share a term-sheet to legal within the week.

Thanks —
Amit

(Attachment: Vertex_procurement_terms.docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Amit Sharma <amit.sharma@vertexhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: On-prem commitment and engineering retainer — pricing approval request

Team —

Looping you both for a quick pricing/legal support decision. Key negotiation points from Vertex:
1) Flexible credit request: prefer a structure that gives them benefit under net-45 (no pre-pay) as well as additional upside for pre-pay. Suggested counter: 30% credit on engineering retainer (year-1) for net-45 + 50% credit if year-1 pre-paid. Cap total credit at $120k.
2) SLA service-credit ask: they want a 30-min Severity1 acknowledgment plus a penalty formula (0.5% monthly fee per hour beyond target up to 10%). We historically accept service credits but prefer a different framing (credits applied to next invoice, with a maximum liability equal to 10% of the month fee).
3) SOW detail: they require milestone-based deliverables for the integration (SSO/KMS, validation hooks). Stephanie, can you confirm the deliverable list and whether 40 architecture hrs included in Option C would cover the 2-FTE onboarding ask?

If this looks ok, I'd like approval to offer the tiered credit (30% net-45 / 50% pre-pay) with the $120k cap and to propose our standard service-credit language (apply credits to next invoice; Redwood liability capped at 10% monthly). We can present that as a commercial counter to procurement today.

Marissa

--- Internal notes (do not forward): David — if price needs to move to get legal to sign faster, we can consider increasing the compute commit discount by 3-5% for year1 only (provided they stick to 36-month minimum).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Sharma <amit.sharma@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: On-prem commitment and engineering retainer — commercial counter and next steps

Amit —

Thanks for the quick feedback. We've reviewed internally and can present the following commercial counter for Vertex to take to legal:

1) Engineering retainer credit (applied to year-1 platform fee):
   - If Vertex prepays year-1 platform fee: 50% credit on annual engineering retainer (up to $120k).
   - If Vertex elects net-45 (no pre-pay): 30% credit on annual engineering retainer (up to $120k).
   - Credit is applied on invoice 1 (post-signature) and shown on the platform fee line item.

2) SLA & service credit:
   - Redwood will commit to a 30-minute acknowledgment for Severity1 incidents under Support Tier 2 and will accept a service credit framework where credits are applied to the next invoice.
   - Liability capped at 10% of the affected month's platform fee (this matches our commercial risk profile).

3) SOW / Deliverables:
   - Updated onboarding SOW will list milestone-based tasks: Kickoff & environment validation (week 1–2), SSO/KMS integration (week 2–8), KV/cache validation and offline data checks (week 4–10), final handoff + runbook (week 11–12).
   - Option C’s 40 architecture hrs covers the integration scope above only if the work is scoped to the milestones; if Vertex requires embedded SW engineering (code changes) we will need to treat that as billable time outside the retainer.

4) Pricing tweak (incentive):
   - As a sign-of-good-faith, if Vertex signs within 14 days of this counter, Redwood will increase Year-1 committed compute discount by an additional 3% (year-1 only).

If that aligns, we'll produce a short commercial term-sheet and the updated SOW for legal to redline. Would you prefer the doc as a Word term-sheet or a redline-ready SOW?

Next steps: if you confirm preference, I'll kick off the SOW update and issue a DocuSign link for the term-sheet.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

(Links/Attachments: Signed_SOW_link.txt, SOW_draft_v1.pdf updated)
